headline: US Treasury Cuts Fourth-Quarter Borrowing Estimate to $618 Billion
summary: The US Treasury has reduced its borrowing estimate for the fourth quarter to $618 billion.
why: US Treasury issuance projections dictate government debt supply levels, directly influencing Treasury yields and broader fixed-income market liquidity.

impacts.name: US Treasury debt issuance
impacts.why: The Treasury explicitly lowered its projected borrowing volume for the quarter.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A lower borrowing estimate reduces the projected supply of government debt, easing potential upward pressure on yields.
